review_corrections_before_release: The initial lifecycle test permitted waiting until the duration limit on an unreaped zombie; the implementation and assertion now explicitly stop at root exit.
The initial host snapshot described the observer cgroup. Target descendant cgroups are now recorded separately with ownership and PID-identity checks; this was not silently relabelled.
boundary: Optional diagnostic, not a causal proof or production repair. Adds one process plus CPU/I/O overhead and must be enabled symmetrically in comparisons. Sampled counts can miss transients; conventional host cgroup layout is assumed. Neither this tool nor its passing tests demonstrate the cause of historical OpenBLAS failures.
